name: navbar-search-filters
goal: Global search opens from a right navbar icon; each catalog has local search and composable filters

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Feature spec defines modal search, revision scope, local filtering and responsive behavior.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extended existing shell search, shared renderer search and collection tests; prior assertions required inline search and covered no composable filters.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red 35a187f7, record ad4cf26af6b1c60f611ca9644e5b02538aa92c1ecf9f24b94da0acb49588d72f: missing Search entities icon and Verification filter.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared modal search and right navbar icon implemented; catalog filters compose with query, changes and ordering.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged regression passed at c5750b7a; sealed green 8998eaca07f394810a6e8990e07969a0b3f4c0cdedf2523d806610ad05065c6e pairs with committed red 35a187f7.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports 575 unit, 76 shell and 65 entity cases plus 16 shared browser and 13 impact cases passed. Inspected browser modal and compact toolbar; native testing remains paused. See verification.md.
